usedFor: Eventzilla takes event registrations and Documint builds documents, so “New Registration” can feed “Add Content To Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Registration” in Eventzilla, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: A new registration is the moment attendee details exist, so the action can put them into a document template.

watchOut: “Registration Is Updated” fires on edits too, so “Add Content To Template” can run again for the same registration.
